## Load Packages
```{r, message = FALSE}
#| code-fold: true

library(DT)
library(hms)
library(here)
library(shiny)
library(ggstar)
library(jsonlite)
library(showtext)
library(htmltools)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)
library(shinydashboard)

# load google font
font_add_google(name = "Manrope", family = "Manrope")
font_add_google(name = "Bowlby One SC", family = "Bowlby")

# turn on showtext
showtext_auto()
```

## Read Data
```{r}
raw_data_1 <- fromJSON(file(here("analysis", "raw_data", "Streaming_History_Audio_2025.json")))
raw_data_2 <- fromJSON(file(here("analysis", "raw_data", "Streaming_History_Audio_2025_1.json")))
raw_data_3 <- fromJSON(file(here("analysis", "raw_data", "Streaming_History_Audio_2025_2.json")))
```

## Clean Data
```{r}
source(here("analysis", "functions", "clean_raw_data.R"))

spotify_data_2025 <- clean_raw_data(raw_data_1, raw_data_2, raw_data_3)
```

## Monthly Wrapped 2025
```{r}
# Month
i <- 12
```

### ValueBoxes
```{r}
# valueBox df

valueBox_df <- spotify_data_2025 %>%
  group_by(month_num) %>%
  summarize(streams = n(),
            tracks = length(unique(track_name)),
            artists = length(unique(artist_name))) %>%
  arrange(desc(streams)) %>%
  mutate(rank = ifelse(row_number() == 1, "1st",
                       ifelse(row_number() == 2, "2nd",
                              ifelse(row_number() == 3, "3rd",
                                     paste0(row_number(), "th")))),
         color = ifelse(rank == "1st", "#D4AF37",
                        ifelse(rank == "2nd", "#C0C0C0",
                               ifelse(rank == "3rd", "#CD7F32",
                                      "#111111"))))
```

```{r}
#| code-fold: true

# streams valueBox
tags$div(
  
  style = ("background-color: black !important; color: white !important;"),
  valueBox(value = valueBox_df$streams[valueBox_df$month_num == i],
           subtitle = "Streams")
  
)
```

```{r}
#| code-fold: true

# tracks valueBox

  style = ("background-color: black !important; color: white !important;"),
  valueBox(value = valueBox_df$tracks[valueBox_df$month_num == i],
           subtitle = "Tracks")
  
)
```

```{r}
#| code-fold: true

# artists valueBox
tags$div(
  
  style = ("background-color: black !important; color: white !important;"),

)
```

```{r}

# rank valueBox

  valueBox(value = valueBox_df$rank[valueBox_df$month_num == i],
           subtitle = "Place",

)
```

### DTs
```{r}
#| code-fold: true

# top 10 songs DT
spotify_data_2025 %>%
  filter(month_num == i) %>%
  group_by(track_name, artist_name) %>%
  summarize(streams = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(streams, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  datatable(colnames = c("Track", "Artist", "Streams"),
            class = "hover",
            options = list(dom = "t"))
```

```{r}
#| code-fold: true

# top 10 artists DT
spotify_data_2025 %>%
  filter(month_num == i) %>%
  group_by(artist_name) %>%
  summarize(streams = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(streams, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  datatable(colnames = c("Artist", "Streams"),
            class = "hover",
            options = list(dom = "t"))
```

### Line Plot
```{r}
#| code-fold: true

max <- spotify_data_2025 %>%
  filter(month_num == i) %>%
  group_by(day) %>%
  summarize(streams = n()) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = streams)

min <- spotify_data_2025 %>%
  filter(month_num == i) %>%
  group_by(day) %>%
  summarize(streams = n()) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = streams)

x_scale_max <- spotify_data_2025 %>%
  filter(month_num == i) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  pull(datetime) %>%
  days_in_month()

avg <- spotify_data_2025 %>%
  filter(month_num == i) %>%
  group_by(day) %>%
  summarize(streams = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(day = 1:x_scale_max, fill = list(streams = 0)) %>%
  summarize(avg_streams = mean(streams))

# daily streams line plot
spotify_data_2025 %>%
  filter(month_num == i) %>%
  group_by(day) %>%
  summarize(streams = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(day = 1:x_scale_max, fill = list(streams = 0)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x = day, y = streams), color = "#6ca200", linewidth = 2, lineend = "round") +
  geom_hline(data = avg, aes(yintercept = avg_streams), linewidth = 2, lineend = "round", linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_star(data = max, aes(x = day, y = streams), size = 5, fill = "black") + 
  geom_point(data = min, aes(x = day, y = streams), shape = 1, size = 5, stroke = 1.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(1, x_scale_max)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0, NA)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Day",
       y = "Streams") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, margin = margin(t = 10)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, margin = margin(r = 10)),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = -0.5),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#303030"),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 0.5, r = 1.5, b = 0.5, l = 0.5, "cm"),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(color = "lightgrey", fill = NA),
        panel.grid = element_line(color = "lightgrey"))
```

### Statistics
```{r}
#| code-fold: true

# highest streaming day
spotify_data_2025 %>%
  filter(month_num == i) %>%
  group_by(month, day) %>%
  summarize(streams = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(order_by = streams) %>%
  mutate(message = paste0("Highest Streaming Day: <b>", month, " ", day, "</b><br>",
                          "Streams: <b>", streams, "</b>")) %>%
  pull(message) %>%
  HTML()
```

```{r}
#| code-fold: true

# percentage of streams for highest streaming day
spotify_data_2025 %>%
  filter(month_num == i) %>%
  group_by(day) %>%
  summarize(streams = n()) %>%
  summarize(pct = max(streams)/sum(streams)*100) %>%
  mutate(message = paste0("The highest streaming day accounted for ", "<b>",
                          signif(pct, digits = 3), "</b>", "<b>%</b>", " of total streams.")) %>%
  pull(message) %>%
  HTML()
```

```{r}
#| code-fold: true

# lowest streaming day(s)
spotify_data_2025 %>%
  filter(month_num == i) %>%
  group_by(month, day) %>%
  summarize(streams = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_min(order_by = streams) %>%
  summarize(message = paste0("Lowest Streaming Day(s): <b>", paste0(month, " ", day, collapse = ", "), "</b><br>",
                             "Stream(s): <b>", streams[1], "</b>")) %>%
  pull(message) %>%
  HTML()
```

```{r}
#| code-fold: true

# quiet day(s)
spotify_data_2025 %>%
  filter(month_num == i) %>%
  group_by(month, day) %>%
  summarize(streams = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(day = 1:x_scale_max, fill = list(streams = 0)) %>%
  fill(month, .direction = "downup") %>%
  filter(streams == 0) %>%
  summarize(message = paste0("Quiet Day(s): <b>", paste0(month, " ", day, collapse = ", "), "</b>")) %>%
  pull(message) %>%
  HTML()
```

```{r}
#| code-fold: true

# average streams per day
spotify_data_2025 %>%
  filter(month_num == i) %>%
  group_by(day) %>%
  summarize(streams = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(day = 1:x_scale_max, fill = list(streams = 0)) %>%
  summarize(avg_streams = mean(streams)) %>%
  mutate(message = paste("Average Streams:", "<b>", signif(avg_streams, digits = 2), "</b>")) %>%
  pull(message) %>%
  HTML()
```

### Histogram
```{r}
#| code-fold: true

# highest streaming day histogram
spotify_data_2025 %>%
  filter(month_num == i, day == max$day) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = time), fill = "#6ca200", bins = 24, boundary = 0, color = "black") +
  scale_x_time(expand = c(0, 0), labels = scales::time_format("%H:%M"),
               limits = c(as_hms("00:00:00"), as_hms("24:00:00"))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as_hms("05:00:00"), linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as_hms("12:00:00"), linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = as_hms("18:00:00"), linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as_hms("22:00:00"), linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text", x =  as_hms("04:30:00"), y = 0, hjust = 0, label = "Morning", size = 5, fontface = "bold", angle = 90) +
  annotate("text", x =  as_hms("11:30:00"), y = 0, hjust = 0, label = "Afternoon", size = 5, fontface = "bold", angle = 90) +
  annotate("text", x =  as_hms("17:30:00"), y = 0, hjust = 0, label = "Evening", size = 5, fontface = "bold", angle = 90) +
  annotate("text", x =  as_hms("21:30:00"), y = 0, hjust = 0, label = "Night", size = 5, fontface = "bold", angle = 90) +
  labs(x = "Time",
       y = "Streams") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, margin = margin(t = 10)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, margin = margin(r = 10)),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = -0.5),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#303030"),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 0.5, r = 1.5, b = 0.5, l = 0.5, "cm"),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(color = "lightgrey", fill = NA),
        panel.grid = element_line(color = "lightgrey"))
```

```{r}
#| code-fold: true

# time of day
spotify_data_2025 %>%
  filter(month_num == i, day == max$day) %>%
   mutate(hour = hour(time),
         time_of_day = case_when(hour >= 5 & hour < 12 ~ "morning",
                                 hour >= 12 & hour < 18 ~ "afternoon",
                                 hour >= 18 & hour < 22 ~ "evening",
                                 hour >= 22 | hour < 5 ~ "night")) %>%
  group_by(time_of_day) %>%
  summarize(total_streams = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_streams)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  mutate(message = paste0("You mostly listened to music during the ", time_of_day,".")) %>%
  pull(message) %>%
  HTML()
```
